name: Splitter
usage: A resizable sidebar or list next to details, editors with a preview, a resizable bottom panel

props.name: children
props.description: The two panes, in order. Each pane scrolls on its own when its content overflows.

props.name: direction
props.description:
`horizontal`: panes side by side with a vertical handle; `vertical`: panes stacked with a horizontal handle.
The Splitter fills its parent, so give the parent a height.

props.name: primary
props.description: The pane whose size is set (`size`, `min`, `max`); the other pane takes the remaining space.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the primary pane in pixels (controlled); use it with `onSizeChange`.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial size of the primary pane in pixels (uncontrolled).

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Called with the new size while dragging and after each keyboard step.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest size of the primary pane in pixels; `Home` collapses the pane to it.

props.name: max
props.description:
Largest size of the primary pane in pixels; `End` expands the pane to it. Never larger than the Splitter
itself.

props.name: step
props.description: Pixels per arrow key press; with `Shift`, four times as much.

props.name: storageKey
props.description:
Saves the size on this device (in `localStorage` under this key) and restores it on the next visit. Use a key
that is unique in your application, such as `'files.sidebar'`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name of the handle, "Resize" by default (follows `locale`); name what it resizes, such as
"Resize the sidebar".

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A resizable list next to the details: drag the handle, or focus it with `Tab` and use `←` / `→`, `Home` and
`End`. The Splitter fills its parent, so the parent needs a height.

examples.name: Vertical
examples.title: Vertical
examples.description:
`direction="vertical"` stacks the panes; with `primary="end"` the size belongs to the bottom panel, and the
top pane takes the rest.

examples.name: Remembered
examples.title: Remembered size
examples.description:
With `storageKey`, the size is saved on this device and restored on the next visit. `onSizeChange` reports
every change.
